token_prefix.description: Non-sensitive prefix for efficient DB lookups (first 8 chars of plaintext token)

is_used.description: Whether the token has been used at least once

challenge.description: Server-only second-factor state (type, user, timestamps). Never written from client input.

user_agent.description: User agent of the browser used during login

last_used_at.description: Timestamp of last login using this token

delivery_status.description: Login e-mail outcome: sent (provider accepted), rejected (refused before acceptance), failed, then bounced or complained when provider feedback arrives. Empty for tokens created without e-mail or before 6.x delivery tracking.

delivery_reason.description: Sanitised reason code (e.g. SMTP_550, HTTP_400, ECONNECTION); never a provider message

delivery_message_id.description: Provider message id, kept server-side to match bounce webhooks
